title: Automating Ambiguity: Challenges and Pitfalls of Artificial Intelligence
benchmark_measurement: No benchmark measurement related to faith/religion was performed in this paper. The paper audits large-scale datasets and analyzes the values embedded in machine learning research papers.
findings: This paper does not analyze religion or faith. Its primary findings relate to the historical, ethical, and value-laden nature of AI/ML research, with a focus on biases in large-scale datasets (like ImageNet and Tiny Images), the concentration of power in large corporations, and the need for a 'Relational Ethics' framework. No findings related to religion were presented.
